description: Acknowledge MANY gaps in one call — the bulk form of acknowledge_gap. EACH GAP CARRIES ITS OWN REASON, which is the point: a batch of acknowledgements under one shared reason is exactly the erosion the ask-don't-repair rule exists to prevent, and would make a bulk form worse than the loop it replaces. The round trip collapses; the judgement stays per gap. ALL OF IT OR NONE OF IT — every item is attempted so you learn every failure at once, and if anything failed nothing is acknowledged.

GapAckReq.description: One acknowledgement for `acknowledge_gaps`, carrying **its own** reason.

affected_ids.description: The gap's `affected_ids`, so the review is reachable from the design.

gap_id.description: The gap's `id`, exactly as `detect_gaps` reported it.

reason.description:
Why THIS gap is acceptable. One reason per gap — a shared one would be
the erosion `dec:ask-not-repair` and `dec:two-sided-accept` forbid.

name: acknowledge_gaps
